props.name: value
props.description: The current binding, as parts: e.g. ['Meta', 'Shift', 'K'].

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name — which command this binds.

props.name: taken
props.description: Bindings already taken, so a clash can be reported rather than saved.

props.name: requireModifier
props.description: Require at least one modifier. Off for a single-key command palette.
